summary: Fix: the war room hall's pre-draw refresh hook was removed when the table left the tree and never restored. A duel reparents the table, so after the first duel in a game the hall stopped refreshing (camera moves and candle flicker would freeze) and each later exit logged 'Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection ... frame_pre_draw'. The hook now follows _EnterTree/_ExitTree.
validation: check.sh --client-only passes; check-duel-match no longer logs any frame_pre_draw disconnect error (the 20 Button mouse_entered/mouse_exited disconnect errors in that check are old: they also appear at 931d2c1f, before the hall viewport existed).
remaining: The Button mouse_entered/mouse_exited disconnect errors in check-duel-match are pre-existing and not addressed here.
